newsitem.title: LATVIA: RAILWAY CARRIAGE MAKER 50 PCT STAKE AUCTIONED.
newsitem.headline: RAILWAY CARRIAGE MAKER 50 PCT STAKE AUCTIONED.

text.p: The controlling stake in Riga railway carriage maker has been auctioned off to Latvian- Ukrainian joint venture Latek, the Diena newspaper reported on Monday.
The company's 50 percent stake or 2.71 million shares were sold for privatisation vouchers worth 16.06 million lats to Latek on Saturday, the newspaper writes.

The payment has to be carried out within a year, the privatisation agency was quoted as saying. After the payment is carried out, an additional 26 percent stake in the company will be sold via a public offer.
Latek has to invest two million lats in the company in the next two years, the newspaper said.
The company's basic capital is 5.4 million lats and it has credits worth 10.04 million lats and debts of 1.66 million lats.
Privatisation agency general manager Janis Naglis was quoted as saying that the auction price, which was eight times higher than the initial auction price, was too high.
"It would be in the company's interests to receive a higher investment from the controlling stake owner than see a high auction price," he said.
